messages:
Ivy: Quick PSA: Pizza roulette happened at lunch and someone won the sacred last slice. chaos and reverence ensued. 
Marco: who won?? was it skill, luck, or bribery with extra garlic knots?
Ritu: Diego performed a mysterious eyebrow raise and the box opened itself. clearly supernatural.
Diego: i simply asked the pizza a question and it responded. i am not responsible for being chosen.
Sam: proposing the nickname "Pizza Oracle" for Diego. immediate branding opportunity. :pizza:
Marco: lore idea: the Last Slice Treaty  whoever gets the last slice must perform a 10-second victory shimmy and offer toppings to the room.
Ivy: also we need to codify the rules: no stealth slice grabs, offer first to the person who brought the pizza, ceremonial napkin for the winner.
Reacji Bot: added :pizza_oracle: emoji (reaction: :sparkles:)
Ritu: poll for merch: sticker (:thumbsup:), patch (:tada:), enamel pin (:heart:), none (:no_entry_sign:)
Sam: :thumbsup:
Diego: :heart: (pin sounds classy)
Marco: :tada: (patch for jackets)
Ivy: outcome: enamel pin + small sticker run. Diego will accept honorary role but refuses mandatory robes.
Sam: onboarding blurb idea: "Respect the Pie - see Last Slice Treaty". add to culture doc?
Ritu: yes but maybe under food etiquette. also add a note: "If you steal the last slice, you must buy pizza next time." enforceable by honor system.
Diego: i will draft a tiny certificate: "Certified Pizza Oracle" to present when the ritual occurs. goes in the kitchen drawer.
Marco: someone should design the pin: tiny pizza slice with a laureate crown. i volunteer as amateur illustrator.
Ivy: production run: 40 pins, 100 stickers. who handles ordering?
Sam: i can do logistics. budget ok? will confirm with ops.
Reacji Bot: pinned message to #random: "Pizza Roulette lore + Last Slice Treaty + pin/sticker plan"
Ritu: future tradition: quarterly pizza roulette during all-hands. rotates who brings the pies.
Diego: i accept the title "Pizza Oracle" and will only use powers for good. also will officiate the treaty ceremonies.
Ivy: this thread is now canon lore. may our slices be equal and our toppings plentiful. :pray:
